serverInfo.name: autonomad-travel
serverInfo.title: Autonomad Travel
serverInfo.description: The agentic social travel platform, in Claude — search live flights (Duffel), hotels (LiteAPI + direct), Viator activities, and Ticketmaster/Bandsintown events, then complete the booking on autonomad.ai. Once signed in, ask Autonomad anything and get an instant answer (message_autonomad), and see what changed on your trips since you last checked (get_updates). Signing up is free.
